title: Glowing book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff9a0" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="42" ry="38" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- Book back cover -->
  <rect x="22" y="30" width="56" height="42" rx="3" fill="#2a5aa8"/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x="25" y="33" width="50" height="36" rx="2" fill="#f0e6c8"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="30" y1="40" x2="70" y2="40" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="46" x2="70" y2="46" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="52" x2="70" y2="52" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="58" x2="70" y2="58" stroke="#d8c8a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Book spine highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="30" width="5" height="42" rx="2" fill="#4a7ad0"/>
  <!-- Open book top edges (curved pages) -->
  <path d="M25 33 Q40 28 50 33 Q60 28 75 33" fill="none" stroke="#fff0b0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Glowing text lines on page -->
  <line x1="34" y1="43" x2="66" y2="43" stroke="#fff9a0" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="49" x2="62" y2="49" stroke="#fff9a0" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="55" x2="58" y2="55" stroke="#fff9a0" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Sparkles around book -->
  <g fill="#fff9a0">
    <polygon points="18,25 19,28 22,28 19.5,30 20.5,33 18,31.5 15.5,33 16.5,30 14,28 17,28"/>
    <polygon points="82,28 83,31 86,31 83.5,33 84.5,36 82,34.5 79.5,36 80.5,33 78,31 81,31"/>
    <polygon points="20,65 21,68 24,68 21.5,70 22.5,73 20,71.5 17.5,73 18.5,70 16,68 19,68"/>
    <polygon points="80,62 81,65 84,65 81.5,67 82.5,70 80,68.5 77.5,70 78.5,67 76,65 79,65"/>
    <polygon points="50,20 51,23 54,23 51.5,25 52.5,28 50,26.5 47.5,28 48.5,25 46,23 49,23"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small glow dots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="2" fill="#fff9a0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="76" r="2" fill="#fff9a0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#fff9a0" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
